parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is the switch lever of the electrical switch, made of durable plastic and designed for manual operation.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the actuator that toggles the electrical connection between on and off states when pressed or flipped.
parts.Movement_description: It moves rotationally or linearly depending on the switch design, allowing user input to change the circuit state.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body of the switch, made of insulating plastic, providing structural support and housing for internal components.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the switch mechanism and electrical contacts securely, ensuring insulation and mechanical stability.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and does not move during operation, serving as the fixed support for the switch assembly.
